Ported by lane STORE1 (blueprint/src/lib/federation/index.mjs:routeFederatedQuery/composeFederatedSlices); lane STORE2 closed the contract-bridge stitching gap. Each federated repository's own persisted generation (loaded read-only from that repo's own .agent/graph/graph.db, independent of the per-repo query-slice result) is converted into a contract_registry::Generation and run through the crate's own contract_registry::build_contract_registry, then every repo's registry is stitched together via contract_registry::stitch_contract_traces -- the same native port membrane-federation's lib_federation_index.rs already calls (membrane_blueprint::contract_registry::stitch_contract_traces). membrane-federation depends on membrane-blueprint, so lib_application_federate.rs calls contract_registry directly rather than through membrane-federation (a membrane-blueprint -> membrane-federation edge would be circular); a repo with no persisted generation contributes no contracts and gets a named repository_generation_unavailable omission instead of a fabricated pass. Legacy's named federation group config (defineFederationGroup) remains unaccepted (only explicit input.repositories, unchanged from STORE1). Covered by tests/parity_application_ops.rs, including new STORE2 test federate_stitches_contract_bridges_from_each_repos_own_generation.
